package.name: sbgc_protocol
package.description:
SimpleBGC32 (BaseCam/AlexMos) serial protocol library, packaged for ament.
This package contains no ROS code and links against no ROS libraries. It builds the byte-verified C core from the vendored simplebgc32-control submodule and exports it as a CMake target, so the protocol has exactly one implementation shared by the ROS driver and the upstream standalone tools.
